description: Building Eurobank's mobile banking app as part of a 35–40 person Android team. Led a large-scale modularization, moving 1,500+ files into 10+ new modules, and brought unit test coverage to modules that previously had none.

Migrated the Sportsbook product to native Android with Jetpack Compose and MVI. Kept the QA rejection rate under 3%, held 96% crash-free sessions over six months and reviewed 50+ pull requests per quarter, using AI-assisted tools (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude, Gemini) to speed up delivery.

Worked on the Viva.com Terminal app, used by 1M+ users in 10+ European countries. Added full tablet and landscape support across 35+ screens, which opened the app up to cash machines and vending machines. Built Kiosk mode in Kotlin and led the app's rebranding.

Built and maintained 15+ Android apps in insurance and loyalty, including the KRAFT Pro App (Impact BITE Awards 2021 winner) and Piraeus Bank's Yellow app, top banking app in Greece for five consecutive years. Tech lead for a year and sole Android developer on several projects, using MVVM, Coroutines, Flow and Room.
